clips.title: The story
paras: Bottles and Baubles is a quest built around the quirky logic that because murlocs look like fish, they must think like them. Adventurers are sent to rummage through a nearby murloc camp for glittering junk and discarded trinkets that an eager angler can fashion into fishing bait.

Bottles and Baubles begins with a rather unusual theory of aquatic biology: that because murlocs are fish-like beings, their minds must function just like the fish swimming in the deep. Driven by this logic, an eccentric angler posits that whatever curious oddities catch a murloc's wandering eye will surely entice a hungry fish on a hook. Scavengers are tasked with venturing into a nearby murloc camp to rummage through their hoard piles and gather shiny discarded junk to test the hypothesis.

Murlocs along coastal waterways and riverbanks are notorious scavengers, hoarding bright stones, shells, bits of polished glass, and metal scraps in messy mounds around their huts. Sifting through these muddy collections yields all manner of glittering refuse that an opportunistic fisherman can fashion into crude lures and flashers. Once retrieved and handed over, the odd assortment proves satisfactory enough to earn the adventurer a set of starter fishing supplies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!
If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
